items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I got into a fight with -- it was with Decca, and I got in a fight with Dave Kapp and we mutually agreed to sever all connections.

ctx.x: Oh, '44, yeah. '43 and '44. No, there wasn't any recording strike. We recorded -- oh, I know what was wrong. I got into a fight with -- it was with Decca, and I got in a fight with Dave Kapp and we mutually agreed to sever all connections. That was -- and I was not with any record company at the time. I think we did make one date for an independent guy. I couldn't even tell you the label. It might have been -- no, it wasn't Atlantic. It was an ill fated venture, because the company never happened. I think they…
Did they ever release the record? The record company didn't last, but I mean did the records ever get out?
